name: Cutaneous Polyarteritis Nodosa

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: No formal standardized criteria; diagnosis based on clinical and histopathological findings

criteria.description: Presence of tender subcutaneous nodules predominantly on lower extremities
Necrotizing vasculitis of small and medium-sized arteries on skin biopsy
Livedo reticularis or racemosa on affected skin
No evidence of systemic polyarteritis nodosa or internal organ involvement

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic skin lesions with histopathologic confirmation of necrotizing vasculitis in the absence of systemic involvement
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of systemic PAN and other vasculitides

pathognomonic.symptomName: Tender subcutaneous nodules on lower extremities
searchTerms: painful lumps under skin on legs

pathognomonic.symptomName: Necrotizing vasculitis of small and medium-sized arteries on skin biopsy
searchTerms: blood vessel inflammation in skin biopsy
skin artery damage with tissue death
mild anemia due to chronic illness
low red blood cells from long-term disease
inflammation under the skin causing lumps

rare.symptomName: Systemic symptoms suggestive of systemic PAN
rare.notes: Should prompt evaluation for systemic disease
searchTerms: whole body symptoms like fever and weight loss
fingers or toes with poor blood flow

laboratory: Mild elevation of inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP)
Normal or mildly elevated white blood cell count
imaging: Doppler ultrasound may show arterial wall thickening in affected skin
Angiography typically normal (no systemic arterial aneurysms)
other: Skin biopsy demonstrating necrotizing vasculitis with fibrinoid necrosis and inflammatory infiltrate

distinguishingFeatures: Histopathology showing leukocytoclastic vasculitis without necrotizing arteritis

redFlags: Development of systemic symptoms (fever, weight loss, malaise)
Signs of internal organ involvement (abdominal pain, hypertension, renal impairment)
Rapidly progressive skin ulcerations or digital ischemia
references: Jennette JC, Falk RJ, Bacon PA, et al. 2012 Revised International Chapel Hill Consensus Conference Nomenclature of Vasculitides. Arthritis Rheum. 2013 Jan;65(1):1-11.
Sunderkötter C, Bonsmann G, Sindrilaru A, Luger TA. Cutaneous vasculitis: update on diagnosis, classification and management. J Dtsch Dermatol Ges. 2014 May;12(5):449-64.
Mahr A, Guillevin L. Cutaneous polyarteritis nodosa: clinical features and treatment. Best Pract Res Clin Rheumatol. 2013 Feb;27(1):123-34.
